notes: Harker Football Green (3WR). The 2025 draft in this league showed every top-four finisher taking a tight end between rounds 3 and 6 while the two teams that waited until rounds 8-9 finished 5th and 6th. That pattern did NOT replicate in Fantasy Steward, where the champion waited until round 8 or 9 in both seasons checked, so it is treated as a soft nudge specific to the three-receiver format rather than a rule.

rules.label: RB-RB start
rules.note: Still the right open here. This league over-drafts receivers — 63 of 180 picks in 2025 — which is exactly what leaves running back value on the table.

rules.label: Tight end by round 6
rules.note: Every top-four finisher in the 2025 Green draft had their TE between rounds 3 and 6; you took yours in round 9 and finished 5th. Round 2 was too early — the manager who spent two of his first three picks on tight ends missed the playoffs. Caveat: this did not replicate in Steward's 2WR format, and it rests on one season of twelve managers.

rules.label: Four skill picks, no TE
rules.note: Four backs and receivers through five rounds with the tight end slot still empty is the shape that finished 5th and 6th in Green last year. Worth a look, not an instruction.

rules.label: QB after the top two
rules.note: No timing signal in the 2025 data — the champion took his quarterback in round 4 and the runner-up in round 8, and both made the final. So this stays a pure price preference: not Josh Allen or Lamar Jackson at their cost.
